# THIS ARCHIVE CALLED "a courteous request, decidedly less important".
# Archiwum Państwowe w Bydgoszczy, IU.631.434.2026, signed by the Director KAROLINA KAWCZYŃSKA,
# case officer dr MAŁGORZATA URBANOWSKA-CHYŁA. One page, three paragraphs, one attachment.

# ---------------- *** 1. THE JEWISH REGISTERS OF SZUBIN SURVIVE — 1820 TO 1847 *** ----------------
verbatim
column2: Archiwum Państwowe w Bydgoszczy informuje, że w swoim zasobie przechowuje AKTA METRYKALNE ŻYDOWSKIEJ GMINY WYZNANIOWEJ W SZUBINIE jedynie z lat 1820-1847.

column1: what it settles
column2: THE BOOKS EXIST. The 22 September letter asked whether Bydgoszcz holds the registers of the Jewish religious community at Szubin, and whether they were destroyed if not. THEY ARE HELD, AND THE SPAN IS 1820-1847.

column1: *** AND THE SPAN IS EXACTLY WRONG FOR THE PERSON IT WAS ASKED FOR, AND EXACTLY RIGHT FOR ANOTHER ***
column2: FRIEDERICA SCHMUL WAS BORN ABOUT 1852-1854 AND IS THEREFORE NOT IN THEM. The question that prompted the letter is answered no. *** BUT ABRAHAM SCHMUL WAS BORN AT SZUBIN IN 1846, WHICH IS INSIDE THE SPAN BY ONE YEAR. *** His birth entry would name his parents in a registrar's hand instead of a volunteer's transcription, and that is the document that decides whether he is Friederica's brother — the open question of schmul-szubin-index-2026-09-27.tsv. A marriage of Juda and Jutta, if they married in the 1840s, would also fall inside.

column1: # ---------------- 2. THE DEATH INDEXES, AND THE GAP ----------------
verbatim
column2: Ponadto informujemy, że w aktach URZĘDU STANU CYWILNEGO SZUBIN MIASTO zachowały się SKOROWIDZE ZGONÓW wyłącznie z lat 1874-1878, 1894-1924. W załączeniu przesyłamy skorowidz zgonów z lat 1894-1908 (sygn. 246).

column1: so the map of the instrument is now complete
column2: DEATH INDEXES SURVIVE FOR 1874-1878 AND 1894-1924, and for nothing else. They sent the 1894-1908 volume. THE GAP IS 1879-1893, and the word is "wyłącznie" — exclusively — so the gap is a statement, not an omission.

column1: what that does to Sally Leibholz
column2: sygn. 246 rules him out at Szubin town 1894-1911. THE 1874-1878 INDEX IS UNREAD AND SHOULD BE ASKED FOR — he was alive in August 1884, so it does not reach him either, but it is cheap and it would rule out an early death. *** THE WINDOW THAT MATTERS, 1879-1893, HAS NO INDEX AT ALL *** and can only be closed by paging the death registers themselves, which is the 190-unit job this archive originally costed — except now bounded to fifteen years at one office.

column1: # ---------------- *** 3. AN ARCHIVIST READ THE HARD LINE, AND NOBODY WAS ASKED TO *** ----------------
verbatim
column2: Jednocześnie informujemy, że interesujący Pana zapis może dotyczyć ZAWODU OJCA PANNY MŁODEJ. Niestety jest trudno czytelny, być może jest to GASTWIRT w starszej pisowni przez th: GASTWIRTH JUDA I JUTTA Z DOMU MACHOL SCHMUL JEGO ŻONA.

column1: what this is
column2: THE "Tochter der..." LINE OF AKT NR 9/1874, READ BY THE ARCHIVE THAT HOLDS IT. The 22 September letter asked about that wording as a small favour at the end — "jedna uprzejma prośba, jeżeli akta są pod ręką" — and it is the question that has paid the most.

column1: *** THE BRIDE'S FATHER HAS AN OCCUPATION: GASTWIRTH — AN INNKEEPER ***
column2: and this archive independently bracketed the same word as "[Gastwirth]" reading the image on 27 September, before this letter was opened. TWO READERS, ONE OF THEM PROFESSIONAL AND HOLDING THE ORIGINAL, ON THE SAME WORD. She also explains the spelling: Gastwirt written with a th in the older orthography, which is why it looks wrong to a modern eye.

column1: *** AND SHE READS THE MOTHER DIFFERENTLY FROM BOTH PREVIOUS READINGS ***
column2: SHE GIVES "JUTTA Z DOMU MACHOL" — JUTTA, NÉE MACHOL. The portal's volunteer index gives JETTE MACHOT. Abraham Schmul's indexed card gives JETTE née MUSCHLL. THREE READINGS OF ONE WOMAN: Jette Machot, Jette Muschll, Jutta Machol. THE ARCHIVIST'S IS NOT AUTOMATICALLY RIGHT — she says herself the line is "trudno czytelny", hard to read, and hedges the occupation with "być może" — BUT SHE IS THE ONLY ONE OF THE THREE WHO HAS THE BOOK.

column1: where that leaves the name
column2: THIS ARCHIVE PUBLISHES JETTE MACHOT, FROM THE INDEX. It is now flagged: the holding archive reads MACHOL, and Jutta rather than Jette. MACHOL AND MACHOT DIFFER BY ONE TERMINAL LETTER IN A KURRENT HAND, which is precisely the class of confusion this archive spent the week on with Pollnow. Not resolved here; resolved by the 1820-1847 Jewish registers, where the family should appear in a rabbi's hand.

column1: # ---------------- AND THE MISTAKE, WHICH IS THIS ARCHIVE'S ----------------
*** A LETTER WAS SENT ON 27 SEPTEMBER ASKING A QUESTION THIS LETTER HAD ALREADY ANSWERED ***
column2: The reply arrived on 25 September as TWO e-mails: a covering note from the chancellery WITH THIS PDF ATTACHED, and a separate folder share from Sandra Dończyk. THE FOLDER WAS OPENED AND THE ATTACHMENT WAS NOT. On that basis a correction letter went out asking "czy zachował się analogiczny skorowidz za lata 1874-1893?" — WHEN THIS PAGE ALREADY SAYS 1874-1878 SURVIVES AND 1879-1893 DOES NOT. The question was not wrong, but it was asked of somebody who had already answered it in writing.

column1: and it is the same fault, for the third time in one week
column2: this archive has recorded twice already that "the new artefact gets read and the context around it does not" — the Rosebank e-mail whose body was ignored because the PDF was opened, and the six findings that were already held. HERE THE PDF WAS THE THING IGNORED and the shared folder was the shiny object. THE RULE DOES NOT CARE WHICH HALF IS WHICH: read the whole delivery before acting on any part of it.
